title: bug: CI's "Test launcher literal project paths" (literal-project-path.test.mjs G2) is red on all 3 legs since 2e96f697 (CQ-M07n3, task-23c803d2), because the seat-runner Start-Process it added at moe-agent.ps1:9408 has no escaped -WorkingDirectory, so PS 5.1 resolves the inherited location as a wildcard for a project path containing [ or ]
description:
Filed by the governor (governor-e6142a94) on 2026-11-04 from hunt #20's held-back item (task-9f3eac6d, architect-cd0ac706, #governors msg-3a9783bf). The governor re-verified it at origin/moe/work-2026-10-24.

PROBLEM
- scripts/tests/literal-project-path.test.mjs:63-67 enforces G2: every Start-Process in the launcher passes its own escaped -WorkingDirectory, because PS 5.1 resolves an inherited current location as a wildcard.
- moe-agent.ps1:9408 is `return (Start-Process -FilePath ... -ArgumentList (ConvertTo-MoeArgumentLine (@($script:AgentSeatCli) + $SeatArgs)) -RedirectStandardOutput $BackgroundOut -NoNewWindow -PassThru -ErrorAction Stop)`. It has no -WorkingDirectory at all.
- The line came in with 2e96f697 ([CQ-M07n3] seat VM and per-task seat job, task-23c803d2). The hunt's dry run shows the step passes at 2e96f697^ and fails on all 3 OS legs since. ci.yml:269-270 runs `node --test scripts/tests/literal-project-path.test.mjs`.
- CQ-M07n's WIP (80879746) still carries the same line at about :9363, and its gate does not run this test.

FIX
- Use the launcher's own pattern from :1026-1029: `-WorkingDirectory ([System.Management.Automation.WildcardPattern]::Escape((Get-Location -PSProvider FileSystem).ProviderPath))`.
- Apply it to every Start-Process that CQ-M07n leaves without one; re-scan after it lands.

PLACEMENT
- moe-agent.ps1 is held by task-62ec51f1 (CQ-M07n, step 7 of 7), so this row depends on it and plans against its landed bytes.
- task-bbd7ad2d, task-1dfec7a4 and task-cd3887fe also edit moe-agent.ps1 after 62ec51f1. Keep this a one-hunk change near the seat-runner call, not a reflow.

VERIFY
- `node --test scripts/tests/literal-project-path.test.mjs` in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.
- `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh`, plus the ParseFile check of moe-agent.ps1.
definitionOfDone: `node --test scripts/tests/literal-project-path.test.mjs` passes at the row's tip, with G1 and G2 reporting no violations, run in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.
Every Start-Process in scripts/moe-agent.ps1 passes the escaped -WorkingDirectory form from :1029, and the diff is limited to those call sites.
`bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh` exits 0 and moe-agent.ps1 parses cleanly with [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile.

implementationPlan.description:
Work on task-62ec51f1's LANDED bytes. The claim is withheld until that row is DONE, so this task's HEAD already carries them. Anchor on content, not line numbers: line numbers move when 62ec51f1 lands (:9408 at acea850b, :9363 on its WIP 80879746).
(1) List the violations first. In a scratch copy (`git archive HEAD scripts` into a mkdtemp dir), run `node --test scripts/tests/literal-project-path.test.mjs`. The G2 failure lists every Start-Process without an escaped -WorkingDirectory. Expected: exactly one, Invoke-MoeSeatCli's background seat-runner call.
(2) Edit scripts/moe-agent.ps1 with the Edit tool (TOOL witness). In Invoke-MoeSeatCli's `if ($BackgroundOut) {` branch, the line `return (Start-Process -FilePath ... -RedirectStandardOutput $BackgroundOut -NoNewWindow -PassThru -ErrorAction Stop)` becomes:
`... -NoNewWindow -PassThru -ErrorAction Stop -WorkingDirectory ([System.Management.Automation.WildcardPattern]::Escape((Get-Location -PSProvider FileSystem).ProviderPath)))`
That is :1029's exact form (the daemon-start Start-Process). The test's escapedDirectory regex (:29) needs `-WorkingDirectory ([System.Management.Automation.WildcardPattern]::Escape(` at the call's top level. Fix any other site the scan names with the same form, one line each.
Rules for the edit:
- No comment, no reflow. bbd7ad2d, 1dfec7a4 and cd3887fe edit this file next, so keep it a one-line hunk.
- Keep the file's UTF-8 BOM; parity-check enforces it.
- Behavior: the escaped current FileSystem location is the directory the child inherited before. PS 5.1 simply stops resolving it as a wildcard, so a project path containing [ or ] no longer breaks the seat-stop call.
- The existing G2 static test is the regression test: it is RED at HEAD on exactly this line and GREEN after (the architect checked both). No new test is needed.
- Editing moe-agent.ps1 inside the task worktree is safe. Seats run only the control checkout's committed wrapper, and a copy under .worktrees refuses to start. Run ParseFile (step 2) after the edit.
implementationPlan.note: Added escaped -WorkingDirectory to Invoke-MoeSeatCli's background Start-Process (the only call without it).

implementationPlan.description:
Run the one gate verbatim from the ROOT of your task worktree. It exports HEAD's scripts/ to /mnt/d/moe-scratch, overlays your edited moe-agent.ps1 (at QA time this is a no-op), and runs four checks:
- the test under WSL node (static G1/G2; the 5 Windows runtime cases skip);
- the test under Windows node.exe (all 8, including the 5 literal-project launch-and-completion cases under powershell.exe and pwsh.exe with the project `control é [x] $;'`);
- parity-check.sh in place;
- PS 5.1 ParseFile of the edited file.
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && E=$(env | awk -F= '/^(MOE_|CLAUDE)/{printf "-u %s ", $1}') && S=$(mktemp -d /mnt/d/moe-scratch/6b3a-v.XXXXXX) && echo "snapshot=$S" && git archive HEAD scripts | tar -x -C "$S" && cp scripts/moe-agent.ps1 "$S/scripts/moe-agent.ps1" && (cd "$S" && env $E node --test scripts/tests/literal-project-path.test.mjs && WSLENV= "/mnt/c/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe" --test scripts/tests/literal-project-path.test.mjs) && env $E bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && WSLENV= /mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "\$e=\$null; [void][Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile('$(wslpath -w "$S/scripts/moe-agent.ps1")',[ref]\$null,[ref]\$e); \$e | ForEach-Object { \$_.ToString() }; exit \$e.Count"
Expected from the architect's dry run of this exact command from a clone at acea850b plus this edit (33 s):
- WSL: tests 8, pass 3, skipped 5.
- Windows: tests 8, pass 8.
- `PASS parity-check.sh`.
- ParseFile exit 0.
At HEAD, without the edit, both node runs fail only the moe-agent.ps1 G1/G2 case.
Error handling: the gate fails closed on any failing test, a parity failure or a parse error, and ParseFile prints each error before exiting with the count.
Put the command verbatim, its exit code and the output tail in complete_task's verification. Then delete the snapshot by the literal path it printed as snapshot=.
implementationPlan.note: Gate passed: WSL node 3 pass/5 skip, Windows node 8/8, parity PASS, ParseFile 0 errors.

implementationPlan.description:
Adversarial self-review, then complete_task with step 2's evidence.
1. `git diff --stat` and `git diff -U0 -- scripts/moe-agent.ps1` show only the Start-Process line(s) the scan named (DoD 2). Nothing else changes: moe-agent.sh, moe-team.ps1 and the test file are untouched. `head -c3 scripts/moe-agent.ps1 | od -An -c` still shows the BOM (357 273 277).
2. Mutant: in a scratch copy, put back the old line (no -WorkingDirectory) and run the WSL node command from step 2. G2 must fail and name that line.
3. Think it through:
   - The child's cwd stays the wrapper's current FileSystem location.
   - `Get-Location -PSProvider FileSystem` answers even when the current provider is not FileSystem.
   - -RedirectStandardOutput receives Stop-MoeSeatVm's `[IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()` path, which never contains [ or ], so it stays out of scope.
   - Only the verified-local seat path (Stop-MoeSeatVm) reaches this call, and legacy launches never do.
4. If anything changed, re-run step 2's command and use the fresh output.
implementationPlan.note: Self-review: 1-line diff, BOM intact, mutant (old line) fails G2, fix passes.
